name: Ultimate Header Footer
author: Tazeen Ehsan

sections.description:
Ultimate Header Footer Builder provides a flexible way to design site headers and footers using WordPress’s native interface or your favorite page builder. Whether you’re managing a single blog or a complex WooCommerce store, create responsive and beautiful layouts that enhance your site’s branding.

Features include:
– Drag-and-drop header/footer builder
– Sticky and transparent header options
– WooCommerce compatibility
– Global settings or per-page overrides

Ideal for beginners and developers alike.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-header-footer directory, or install through the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Appearance → Header Footer Builder to start designing.
sections.faq:
Will it affect my theme’s styling?

We try to inherit your theme’s styling gracefully. You can always override styles via custom CSS.

short_description: Easily build custom headers and footers for your WordPress site with a visual interface. No coding required—just drag, drop, and publish.
